statement: Theorem D (Discrete Grade-Orbit Temperedness Criterion) and Failure of Coordinate Naturality to Imply Grade-Uniform Temperedness: Let a = log(tau) > 0 with tau = 2*pi. For any distribution T in D'(R), T extends continuously to S'(R) if and only if there exist constants C > 0, integers N, m >= 0, and a compact neighborhood I such that for all K in Z and all phi in C_c^infty(I), |<T, phi(.-Ka)>| <= C (1 + |K|)^N ||phi||_{C^m(I)}. The proof is analytical (Schwartz 1951, Chap. VII; Hormander 1983, Thm 7.1.14) via a smooth partition of unity sum_{K in Z} theta(u - Ka) = 1 subordinate to aZ. For the normalized Chebyshev prime error E(u) = exp(-u/2)(psi(exp u) - exp u), this yields the conditional equivalence chain: GradeOrbitBound(E) <=> T_E in S'(R) <=> RH. In the transcendental continuation (TC) axiom hierarchy: Level P0 (Pointwise Coordinate Naturality: exact invertible grade translation u' = u + Ka) and Level P1 (Global Distribution Gluing: grade slices embed as pullbacks of an ambient distribution in D'(R)) are satisfied by existing TC for all modes, including off-critical modes f_{delta,gamma}(u) = exp((delta + i*gamma)u) with delta != 0. Choosing a certified test function phi in C_c^infty(I) with support radius epsilon <= 1/(2*(1+|gamma|)) guarantees Re int_I exp((delta+i*gamma)v) phi(v) dv > 0, precluding phase cancellation. Level P2 (Uniform Finite-Order Polynomial Grade-Orbit Bound) is strictly violated by the off-line mode, whose grade orbit |<T_f, phi(.-Ka)>| = tau^{K*delta}|J_0| grows exponentially in whichever direction sgn(K) = sgn(delta), outgrowing any polynomial in K. Thus, P0 + P1 does not imply P2. This countermodel scopes strictly to coordinate naturality and ambient gluing; it does not automatically disprove a bridge from the complete Euler product or explicit formula. Lean formalizes the priority bilateral theorem: polynomial_bilateral_grade_growth_implies_delta_zero (any bilateral polynomial bound on exp(K*delta*log tau) forces delta = 0 for tau > 1). Therefore, existing TC axioms do not imply the uniform grade-orbit control needed for temperedness; for prime arithmetic, polynomial grade-orbit control is strictly equivalent to RH.

exact_conclusion: Theorem D establishes GradeOrbitBound(E) <=> T_E in S'(R) <=> RH. Existing TC coordinate naturality (P0) and ambient distribution gluing (P1) do not imply uniform polynomial grade-orbit bounds (P2), as witnessed by the exponential countermodel. Lean proves that bilateral polynomial grade-orbit growth forces delta = 0.
logical_negation: Existing TC axioms force P2 for all covariant modes, or off-line modes with delta != 0 satisfy bilateral polynomial grade growth, or Theorem D fails to characterize temperedness (FALSIFIED / REFUTED)
falsification_attempts: Gate 1 & 4 (Theorem D Analytical Proof & Equivalence Audit): derived the exact analytical equivalence 1 <=> 2 via a smooth partition of unity theta subordinate to aZ (Schwartz 1951, Tome II Chap. VII; Hormander 1983, Thm 7.1.14), where absolute convergence of local pairings sum_K (1+|K|)^{N-(N+2)} < infty establishes tempered continuity on S(R); numerical tests verified partition-of-unity identity to < 1e-65 error

Gate 2 & 5 (Axiom Hierarchy Separation & Boundary Dominance): proved that Level P0 (exact coordinate covariance) and Level P1 (ambient distribution gluing) hold identically for off-line mode f_{delta,gamma}(u) = exp((delta+i*gamma)u), while boundary dominance in the asymptotic limit |K| -> infty is dominated by exponential divergence

Gate 3 & 9 (Exponential Countermodel Falsification with Certified Bump): constructed a certified test function phi in C_c^infty(I) with radius epsilon <= 1/(2*(1+|gamma|)) such that Re int_I exp((delta+i*gamma)v) phi(v) dv > 0, ruling out phase cancellation and proving that |<T_f, phi(.-Ka)>| = tau^{K*delta}|J_0| grows exponentially, proving P0 + P1 does not imply P2

Gate 6 & 7 (Lean Formalization of Priority Bilateral Theorem): formalized polynomial_bilateral_grade_growth_implies_delta_zero in Lean 4 without axioms beyond standard mathlib, proving that bilateral polynomial grade growth forces delta = 0
Gate 8 (Independence and Premise Audit): proved that asserting P2 for prime error E(u) is mathematically equivalent to assuming RH, isolating the exact missing premise of Transcendental Continuation

Gate 10 (Dual Status Classification): marked SPECIFICATION_SCHEMA_PASSED for structural gates while rigorously documenting that P2 is not supplied by existing TC axioms and remains an RH-equivalent condition
